stakeholders: Human reviewer: understands outcome and chooses rework or complete.
Main Agent: presents sanitized evidence and invokes canonical managers.
Workflow Agent: executes rework in the linked worktree.
Repository maintainer: owns lifecycle semantics and integration safety.
approvalBoundaries: Human owns acceptance, rework instructions, and risk acceptance.
Main Agent must not expose internal scripts or absolute worktree paths and must not decide complete.
